prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women, one seated on a stone throne and one kneeling at her feet.

#1: a warm caramel complexion, early 50s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, high ponytail golden blonde hair — wearing a minimal denim cowgirl costume of a tiny denim top of two small opaque cups tied in a knot at the front, tiny low-rise denim micro shorts with their hems at the very top of her thighs, a wide leather belt with a large silver buckle and a tan cowboy hat, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her stomach bare. She wears a wide black leather collar with a polished steel ring at the front, snug around her neck. She sits tall on the throne with her legs crossed at the knee, a slender black leather riding crop with a small flat leather tip resting across her knee in her right hand, her left hand resting on the stone armrest. Pose: seated upright on the stone throne facing the camera, her legs crossed at the knee, her chin lifted, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
#1: Footwear: pointed stiletto pumps made of glossy blue denim, each with a thin tapered six-inch heel, her feet resting naturally.
#1: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy blue denim with a high polish.
#1: Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#1: Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.

#2: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smooth healthy skin, defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips, a poised, mature, confident expression, cool and composed, bright golden-blonde hair styled in braided, real living eyes. Long oval nails, glossy finish.
#2: Physique: An extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame. Solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
#2: Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer — glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
#2: Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb down to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the flagstone floor on its own side in front of her, her arms stretched down and slightly apart. Pose: kneeling upright on both knees on the flagstone floor at the foot of the throne, facing the camera, her shoulders drawn back, her chin lifted, her arms stretched down and slightly forward by the chains, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
#2: Footwear: pointed clear stiletto pumps, each with a thin tapered six-inch heel, her feet resting naturally.

Environment: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with a heavy carved stone throne with high stone arms and a high stone back set against a rough-cut stone block wall, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the stone walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the seated woman and the kneeling woman both completely visible from their feet to the top of their heads, with the stone walls, the vaulted ceiling and the flagstone floor around them at normal human scale. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
